title: Tesadüf
description: This graph represents characters as nodes and segment-level co-occurrences as undirected weighted edges. Node attributes include manually provided character metadata and GPT-extracted character features. Edge weights indicate the number of 300-word overlapping segments in which the two characters co-occur. Relation labels are included only for high-frequency co-occurring pairs selected during relation extraction.

nodes.label: Gülsüm Hanım
nodes.notes: Woman who becomes anxious after seeing a text about 'Pasaklı Gülsüm' and seeks help from Hoca Nefise Hanım.

nodes.label: Hoca Nefise Hanım
nodes.notes: Neighborhood woman known as a hoca/püfçü. She manipulates Gülsüm's fears and benefits from her through charms, readings, and superstition.

nodes.label: Rıfkı Efendi
nodes.notes: Gülsüm's husband. He is suspected by Gülsüm and Nefise of writing the 'Pasaklı Gülsüm' text and planning to remarry.

nodes.label: Hacı Baba
nodes.notes: Nefise Hanım's husband. Often appears in comic domestic scenes and is shown as passive in relation to Nefise.

nodes.label: Zübeyde
nodes.notes: Rıfkı's mother / Gülsüm's mother-in-law figure, described as disabled or bedridden and dependent in the household.

nodes.label: Vefa
nodes.notes: Gülsüm and Rıfkı's son; mentioned in relation to household food, school, and family conflict.

nodes.label: Gülsüm'ün annesi
nodes.notes: Gülsüm's mother. Appears in the household and later accompanies or supports Gülsüm in some events.

nodes.label: Seher
nodes.notes: Neighbor from the İmameciler household. Appears in neighborhood quarrels and later joins Gülsüm's group in confronting Nefise.

nodes.label: İmameciler ailesi
nodes.notes: Neighboring family involved in quarrels with Nefise and Gülsüm.

nodes.label: Sarman
nodes.notes: Nefise Hanım's cat; important in the comic pastırma episode.

nodes.label: Tekir
nodes.notes: Neighbor's cat, mentioned during the quarrel about cats and stolen food.

nodes.label: Saibe
nodes.notes: Later character connected to visits to Nefise's house.

nodes.label: Şöhret
nodes.notes: Later character connected to visits to Nefise's house.

nodes.label: Salim
nodes.notes: A different groom candidate confused with Rıfkı Efendi in the later misunderstanding scene.

nodes.label: Küçük Şaban
nodes.notes: Coffeehouse boy mentioned when Nefise asks Gülsüm to call Hacı Baba from the coffeehouse.

nodes.label: Sabbek
nodes.notes: Nefise Hanım's daughter, mentioned as being sent to a mansion as a servant/besleme.
